headline: The lanes grade takes now — Jon just plays
lede: PLAICRAFT #2157 shipped (#2219): new phone takes get replayed, clap-checked and graded on #1711 by the lanes themselves, with the store key living once in a gitignored local file instead of every command line.

notes.text: plaicraft:grade posts a PLAIGRADE verdict per new take — replay, voice, clap, seats — idempotent via the marker line, and never printing the key (asserted in the self-test).
Evidence downloads retry 4x with backoff, so a seed42-style dropped fetch no longer reads as a failed take; permanent failures still FAIL, naming the attempt count (mutant-proven).
JON_KEY resolves env-first then .env.local at the worktree or shared repo root — one file at the studio serves every lane worktree (jonq #2218 has the one-time command).
A spawnSync against an in-process loopback sim deadlocks: the blocked parent starves its own server. Lesson logged; grade spawns async.
